conclusion: Thirty-five refutation attempts were run against the subject and all thirty-five were refuted against live repository bytes. The mode-0444 subject is unmoved at the expected digest. Live HEAD is D-225 at d2973ceb..., the last live COORD heading is D-225, and the governing files are unmodified in the working tree. All eight cited digests recompute exactly. The register cardinalities the draft asserts were independently recounted from file 08 rather than carried forward: 32 gate rows all with owners, exactly 28 carrying a named harness cell, DR-G32 last, DR-G26 and DR-131 both OPEN. The fifty-nine-entry non-unwrite span is complete, ordered, duplicate-free, and every cited number resolves to a live heading, with D-168 and D-225 both present. Every prohibition in the review prompt is honoured, and the eighteen-gate rewrite list matches the recorded-occupancy set exactly. The strongest available attack, the frozen artifact's gates2and3Hold=false field, fails because the draft disclaims the claim and the configuration is house-normal across four adopted predecessors. No MUST-FIX and no SHOULD-FIX survive.
